name: Rowan Blackwell
source:
One of the heroes who defeated the last Demon Lord Karnas in the war seven years ago and saved thus the Six Realms from eternal darkness.
Since this he lived with his childhood sweetheart and wife Alexia in the uneventfull village of Arthdale in Rosaria.
Till the day an unkwown lady in distress reached their home in need of help. And so once again Rowan dones his armour and graps his sword.
